name: io.github.theYahia/robokassa-mcp
title: Robokassa
description: Robokassa - signed payment links with optional 54-FZ receipt, invoice status (Russia)

environmentVariables.name: ROBOKASSA_LOGIN
environmentVariables.description: Merchant login (store identifier) from the Robokassa cabinet

environmentVariables.name: ROBOKASSA_PASSWORD1
environmentVariables.description: Password #1, used to sign payment URLs

environmentVariables.name: ROBOKASSA_PASSWORD2
environmentVariables.description: Password #2, used to verify result URLs and check invoice state

environmentVariables.name: ROBOKASSA_TEST
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to generate links in test mode
